texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系中发现了战略资源：“泽珞”的储备。

这种稀有气溶胶具有多种用途。分析表明，经过处理的样本甚至能影响具有“灵能”特性的[Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]个体——例如虚境造物——的机能。凭借我们的蒸馏泽珞技术，只要控制[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]星系就能实现该资源的开采。

texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered deposits of the strategic resource ID: 'Zro' in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.

This rare aerosol has many applications. Analysis has shown that processed samples can even affect the functioning of [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] units with 'psionic' properties, such as the Shroud-Forged. With our Zro Distillation technology, we will be capable of extracting this resource if we control the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.

We are sure to find more of these types of resources as we continue to explore the galaxy, each with unique properties and applications.

tooltips.zh:
£sr_zro£泽珞
一种在异星粒子中存在的极其稀有的气溶胶，随着陨石撞击被一起发现。不过其真正的来源依然是个未解之谜。若拥有灵能天赋的[GetIndividualNamePlural]将泽珞[GetIngestedLoc]后，它会是一种能极大的提高灵能力量（并可能导致成瘾）的[GetDrugLoc]。
tooltips.en:
£sr_zro£Zro
An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If [GetIngestedLoc] by psionically-gifted [GetIndividualNamePlural], zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) [GetDrugLoc] that enhances psionic abilities.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为泽珞。

这种稀有的气溶胶表现出一种异常的神经侵入效应特性，因此被指定为一类A级管制品。它在开发精神隔离技术方面可能具有价值。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Zro in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system.

The properties of this rare aerosol have been noted to exhibit anomalous neuroinvasive effects, and has therefore been designated as a class alpha controlled substance. It may yet prove valuable in developing mentally insulative technologies.

We are sure to find more of these types of resources as we continue to explore the galaxy, each with unique properties and applications.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为稀有水晶。它们在聚焦极光束方面十分有效，同时也是许多先进电子用品的必备材料。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Rare Crystals in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. They have properties that help focus laser beams, and are also a critical component in most advanced electronics.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为异星天然气。这些气体具有多种潜在用途，包括用于先进能量武器、立场护盾、飞船染料甚至作为消遣性药品使用。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Exotic Gases in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. They have various potential applications, including advanced energy-based weaponry, force fields, starship fuel, and even recreational drugs.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系内发现了一种此前未知的战略资源，称为易爆微粒。这些微粒中蕴含着大量的能量，作为能源、燃料甚至炸药都十分出色。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Volatile Motes in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. They contain immense energy, with applications ranging from energy production and fuel to explosives.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为泽珞。这是一种来源不明的气溶胶，[Root.Owner.GetIngestedLoc]后可以让拥有天赋的[Root.Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural]提升灵能力。$action.92.part3$

It is a rare aerosol of unknown origin, and when [Root.Owner.GetIngestedLoc], it enhances the abilities of psionically-gifted [Root.Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural].$action.92.part3$

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为暗物质。它似乎打破了一些物理法则，具有引发科学革命的潜力。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Dark Matter in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. It seemingly defying several natural laws, and could potentially revolutionize the sciences.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.Fleet.GetStarName]恒星系发现了一种前所未知的战略资源，称为活体金属。其具有通常只能在有机生物形式上才能见到的特性，会自动恢复成被稳定塑造好的形态。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] has discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Living Metal in the [Root.Fleet.GetStarName] system. It has characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms, and will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.

texts.zh: 在对[From.GetStarName]进行调查时，[Root.GetName]发现了一种新的战略资源，称为星界丝缕。它在扭曲时空方面的独特性质可以用在若干有趣的用途。
texts.en: During its survey of [From.GetStarName], the [Root.GetName] discovered a previously unknown strategic resource dubbed Astral Threads. Its unique properties in distorting time and space could be put to use in a number of interesting ways.

texts.zh:
我们拥有相应的科技——要是能够控制该恒星系，就能攫取这份资源。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
texts.en:
We have the technology - if we control this system, we can extract this resource.

We are sure to find more of these types of resources as we continue to explore the galaxy, each with unique properties and applications.

texts.zh:
虽说我们尚不能提取这种资源，但应该考虑在该星系建立控制，以便日后开发。

在探索星系的过程中我们肯定定能找到更多这样的资源，带来独特的性质和用途。
texts.en:
We cannot extract this resource yet, but we could establish control over the system for future exploitation.

We are sure to find more of these types of resources as we continue to explore the galaxy, each with unique properties and applications.

tooltips.zh:
£rare_crystals£稀有水晶
这些水晶拥有独特的属性，非常适合用来凝聚和集中激光束，同时也是制作大部分高级电子器材的关键材料。部分文化也视之为装饰物。
tooltips.en:
£rare_crystals£Rare Crystals
These crystals have properties that make them extremely effective at focusing laser beams, and they are also a critical component in most advanced electronics. In addition, many cultures treasure them as decorations and adornments.

tooltips.zh:
£exotic_gases£异星天然气
罕见的异星天然气拥有各种用途，主要是用来为高级能量武器和能量力场提供能源。部分也用作舰船燃料或消遣性毒品。
tooltips.en:
£exotic_gases£Exotic Gases
Rare and exotic gases with a variety of different uses, particularly in the operation of advanced energy-based weaponry and force fields. Some of the gases can also be used as starship fuel or even as recreational drugs.

tooltips.zh:
£volatile_motes£易爆微粒
这些超自然粒子蕴含有惊人的能量，可以被精炼为能源或者用作燃料和炸药。
tooltips.en:
£volatile_motes£Volatile Motes
These preternatural particles contain a tremendous amount of energy which could be exploited in energy production, as fuel or even as explosives.

tooltips.zh:
£sr_zro£泽珞
一种在异星粒子中存在的极其稀有的气溶胶，随着陨石撞击被一起发现。不过其真正的来源依然是个未解之谜。若拥有灵能天赋的[GetIndividualNamePlural]将泽珞[GetIngestedLoc]后，它会是一种能极大的提高灵能力量（并可能导致成瘾）的[GetDrugLoc]。
tooltips.en:
£sr_zro£Zro
An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If [GetIngestedLoc] by psionically-gifted [GetIndividualNamePlural], zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) [GetDrugLoc] that enhances psionic abilities.

tooltips.zh:
£sr_dark_matter£暗物质
这种神秘物质具有许多似乎可以打破所谓自然法则的性质。该物质仅在黑洞周围或部分星云附近才能达到可供开采的浓度。
tooltips.en:
£sr_dark_matter£Dark Matter
This exotic substance has many properties that seemingly defy several natural laws. Harvestable concentrations can only be found near Black Holes or in certain nebulas.

tooltips.zh:
£sr_living_metal£活体金属
该无机金属有着通常生命体才具备的特征。会自动恢复到其被塑造好的形态。
tooltips.en:
£sr_living_metal£Living Metal
This inorganic metal shows characteristics usually seen only in biological life forms. It will always attempt to regenerate back into the shape it was stabilized into.

tooltips.zh:
£astral_threads£星界丝缕
£astral_threads£星界丝缕是一种时空浓缩而来的细丝，是不同维度位面互相碰撞的产物。可以用来产生各种全国范围的效果。
tooltips.en:
£astral_threads£Astral Threads
£astral_threads£ Astral Threads are filaments of condensed space-time: the result of dimensional planes colliding with one another. They can be spent to enact various empire-wide effects.

# 发现泽珞矿藏 / Zro Deposit Discovered

- 分类 Category: C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources: events/on_action_events_1.txt:7975-8250; common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1151 on_survey_planet · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

勘测到战略资源矿点时（00_on_actions.txt:1151），隐藏事件 action.941 对尚未标记 strategic_resource_found 的国家作首次发现提示。

When a survey finds a strategic resource deposit (00_on_actions.txt:1151) hidden action.941 shows the first-discovery notice for a country without strategic_resource_found.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

按起源与资源分流：虚境铸造者发现泽珞——action.942；心灵守望者发现泽珞——action.943（并推进 tech_mine_zro 10%）；其余——action.94（按资源种类显示不同正文；若已有相应科技则显示 has_tech 版本）。之后的资源发现只发送信息提示，不再弹窗。

Split by origin and resource: Shroud-Forged finding Zro - action.942; Mindwardens finding Zro - action.943 (also 10% progress on tech_mine_zro); everyone else - action.94 (text varies by resource, with a has_tech variant if the tech is already known). Later discoveries only send a message, no window.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

本导读未单列条件差异；条件随各事件在上文说明，阅读器按文明设定显示可能的版本。/ This guide does not list conditions separately; they are described with each event above, and the reader shows the possible variants for the chosen empire profile.
